health_short: Stop if you feel pain. This app gives general information, not medical advice.
health_text: This app records exercise and gives general information. It does not diagnose and gives no medical advice. Stop if you feel pain or discomfort and ask a health professional if needed.
routine_hint: Tip: when you finish a workout you can save it as your own routine.
cancel_workout_text: The workout and its sets are deleted.
location_denied: Location permission is needed to record a route.
finish_activity_text: Stop recording and save the route?
too_short: The recording was too short and was not saved.
delete_activity_text: The route is deleted. This cannot be undone.
steps_no_sensor: This phone has no step sensor.
stride_note: Used to turn steps into distance. Roughly your height × 0.41.
no_history: Nothing here yet. Start a workout or an outdoor activity.
backup_note: Saves all workouts, routines and routes in one file protected by your password. Restoring replaces the data on this phone.
password_note: At least 8 characters. A forgotten password cannot be recovered.
restore_confirm: Backup from %3$s: %1$d workouts, %2$d activities. Your current data will be replaced.
err_wrong_password: Wrong password or damaged file. Nothing was changed.
err_bad_file: Not a valid backup. Nothing was changed.
err_newer: Made by a newer app version. Update the app first.
err_io: The file could not be read or written.
about_text: Free software (GPL-3.0-or-later). No ads, no trackers, no account; everything stays on your phone. Exercise pictures and texts are original work (CC-BY-SA-4.0). Maps © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
wipe_text: Deletes all workouts, routines, routes and settings from this app and restarts it. Exported files stay.
key_lost_text: The device key protecting your data is missing (for example after a system restore). Reset the app, then restore a backup if you have one.
ex_push_up_steps:
Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up.
ex_knee_push_up_steps:
Knees on the mat, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest.
Push back up.
ex_chair_dip_steps:
Hands on the edge of a stable chair behind you.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Straighten your arms to rise.
ex_biceps_curl_steps:
Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides.
Bend your elbows and lift the weights.
Lower slowly.
ex_shoulder_press_steps:
Dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them straight up.
Lower back to the shoulders.
ex_lateral_raise_steps:
Dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
ex_bent_over_row_steps:
Lean forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Pull the dumbbells towards your hips.
Lower them again.
ex_squat_steps:
Feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down, chest up.
Push through your heels to stand.
ex_goblet_squat_steps:
Hold one dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down, back straight.
Stand up.
ex_lunge_steps:
Take a big step forward.
Lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push back and switch legs.
ex_glute_bridge_steps:
Lie on your back, knees bent.
Lift your hips.
Lower slowly.
ex_calf_raise_steps:
Stand tall.
Rise onto your toes.
Lower slowly.
ex_wall_sit_steps:
Back against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent at a right angle.
Hold.
ex_plank_steps:
Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Body in one straight line.
Hold and breathe.
ex_side_plank_steps:
Lie on your side on one forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.
ex_crunch_steps:
Lie on your back, knees bent.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.
ex_leg_raise_steps:
Lie on your back, legs straight.
Raise your legs up.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
ex_bird_dog_steps:
On hands and knees, back flat.
Stretch one arm and the opposite leg.
Return and switch sides.
ex_superman_steps:
Lie face down, arms forward.
Lift arms and legs a little.
Hold briefly and lower.
ex_jumping_jack_steps:
Stand with feet together.
Jump feet apart, arms overhead.
Jump back and repeat.
ex_high_knees_steps:
Run on the spot.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Swing your arms.
ex_mountain_climber_steps:
Start in a high plank.
Pull one knee towards your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
route_hint: Walks, hikes and runs on the map
breath_hint: Breathe in for 4 s, out for 6 s. Calms the mind.
how_xp_text: 1 XP per 100 steps · 5 XP per glass of water · 2 XP per set · 10 XP per km on a route · 20 XP per yoga or breathing session · 10 XP for logging your weight · +25 XP for each daily quest, +50 XP when all four are done. A streak day needs at least two quests.
b_hydrated_7_d: Water goal 7 days in a row
b_perfect_day_d: All four quests in one day
reminders_note: Friendly nudges for your daily quests. They stay quiet once a goal is reached. Delivery can be a little late because of battery saving.
rem_water_text: %1$d of %2$d glasses today. One glass = +5 XP.
rem_move_text: Only %1$s steps to today's goal. A short walk?
rem_move_text_nosteps: A short walk keeps your streak alive.
rem_workout_text: A quick routine completes today's move quest: +25 XP.
rem_streak_text: Your %1$d-day streak is waiting. Keep the fire going! 🔥
rem_yoga_text: One minute of breathing or a short yoga flow: +20 XP.
ex_yoga_mountain_steps:
Stand tall, feet together.
Raise your arms overhead.
Breathe calmly and hold.
ex_yoga_tree_steps:
Stand on one leg.
Place the other foot on your calf or thigh, not the knee.
Arms up, hold, then switch.
ex_yoga_warrior_steps:
Step your feet wide apart.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Stretch your arms out and hold.
ex_yoga_triangle_steps:
Feet wide, legs straight.
Reach to the side and lower one hand to your shin.
Raise the other arm and hold.
ex_yoga_downward_dog_steps:
Start on hands and knees.
Lift your hips up and back.
Press heels towards the floor and hold.
ex_yoga_cobra_steps:
Lie face down, hands under shoulders.
Gently lift your chest.
Keep the hips down and hold.
ex_yoga_child_steps:
Kneel and sit back on your heels.
Fold forward, forehead down.
Stretch your arms forward and relax.
ex_yoga_forward_bend_steps:
Sit with legs straight.
Lengthen your back with arms up.
Fold forward gently and hold.
ex_yoga_bridge_steps:
Lie on your back, knees bent.
Lift your hips.
Breathe and hold.
ex_yoga_savasana_steps:
Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Close your eyes.
Relax every muscle and breathe slowly.
all_done_text: Every exercise is done. Finish to collect your XP.
location_off_text: Turn on your phone's location (GPS) so walks, hikes and runs can be recorded on the map.
precise_text: With approximate location only, routes and distances are very rough. Allow precise location for this app.
radio_error: Radio list could not be loaded. Check your connection.
radio_note: Station list from radio-browser.info (free, no account). Your search and IP go to that service; the stream comes from the station.
radio_play_error: This station cannot be played right now.
body_empty: Log your weight to see your BMI and progress.
bmi_need_height: Enter your height and log a weight to see your BMI.
bmi_range: A normal BMI at your height: %1$s – %2$s
bmi_note: BMI is a rough guide for adults and does not consider muscle, age or body shape. It is not a diagnosis.
ex_pilates_hundred_steps:
Lie on your back, legs lifted, head and shoulders up.
Arms long beside you, pump them up and down.
Breathe in for 5 pumps, out for 5.
ex_pilates_roll_up_steps:
Lie on your back, arms overhead.
Roll up slowly, one vertebra at a time, reaching for your toes.
Roll back down with control.
ex_pilates_single_leg_steps:
Lie on your back, head and shoulders up.
Pull one knee in, stretch the other leg long.
Switch legs smoothly.
ex_pilates_leg_circle_steps:
Lie on your back, one leg up to the ceiling.
Draw small circles with that leg, hips still.
Change direction, then switch legs.
ex_pilates_swimming_steps:
Lie face down, arms and legs long.
Lift arms, chest and legs a little.
Flutter opposite arm and leg quickly.
ex_pilates_teaser_steps:
Lie on your back, legs lifted at an angle.
Roll up into a V, arms reaching to your feet.
Hold briefly and roll down slowly.
badges_hint: Tap a badge to see how to earn it.
bmi_sex_note: BMI bands are the same for women and men; the reference weight (Devine formula) differs by sex.
calm_breath_hint: In for 4 s, out for 6 s. Slows the heart and calms the mind.
calm_box_hint: In 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4. Clears the head before a task.
calm_478_hint: In 4, hold 7, out 8. Helps you fall asleep.
calm_body_scan_hint: Move your attention slowly through the body and let each part relax.
calm_grounding_hint: Use your senses to come back to the present moment.
calm_relax_hint: Tense each muscle group for 5 seconds, then let it go.
calm_gratitude_hint: Think of three good things. A warm way to start or end the day.
scan_1: Sit or lie comfortably. Close your eyes and breathe slowly.
scan_2: Notice your feet and legs. Let them grow heavy and soft.
scan_3: Feel your belly rise and fall. Let your lower back relax.
scan_4: Let your shoulders drop. Arms and hands become heavy.
scan_5: Soften your face: forehead, eyes, jaw. Unclench your teeth.
scan_6: Feel your whole body at rest. Stay here for a few breaths.
ground_1: Look around and name 5 things you can see.
ground_2: Notice 4 things you can touch or feel.
ground_5: Notice 1 thing you can taste. Then take a slow, deep breath.
relax_1: Make fists, squeeze for 5 seconds… and let go.
relax_2: Pull your shoulders up to your ears… hold… and drop them.
relax_3: Scrunch your face tight… hold… and soften it.
relax_4: Tighten your belly… hold… and breathe out as it relaxes.
relax_5: Press your legs together and point your toes… hold… release.
relax_6: Let your whole body go loose and heavy. Breathe slowly.
thanks_1: Think of one person you are thankful for today.
thanks_2: Remember one small moment that made you smile.
thanks_3: Name one thing your body did well for you today.
med_morning_hint: Start the day clear and grateful, with birdsong.
med_stress_hint: Come back to the moment, then slow your breathing. With flowing water.
med_focus_hint: Box breathing and a body scan before work or study. With forest sounds.
med_sleep_hint: 4-7-8 breathing, muscle relaxation and a body scan. With soft rain.
ex_donkey_kick_steps:
On hands and knees, back flat.
Kick one leg up, knee bent, sole to the ceiling.
Squeeze the glute, lower slowly, switch sides.
ex_single_leg_bridge_steps:
Lie on your back, one knee bent, the other leg straight.
Push through the heel and lift the hips.
Lower slowly; switch legs halfway.
ex_sumo_squat_steps:
Feet wide, toes turned out, hands on hips.
Bend the knees and sit straight down.
Push up through the heels and squeeze the glutes.
ex_side_lunge_steps:
Stand tall, hands on hips.
Step wide to one side and bend that knee; the other leg stays straight.
Push back to the middle; alternate sides.
ex_jump_squat_steps:
Squat down with the arms back.
Jump up explosively, arms overhead.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next one.
ex_bicycle_crunch_steps:
Lie on your back, hands behind your head, shoulders up.
Bring one knee in and turn the opposite elbow towards it.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
ex_russian_twist_steps:
Sit, lean back a little, feet lifted or on the floor.
Turn your chest and hands to one side.
Turn to the other side; keep the back long.
ex_flutter_kick_steps:
Lie on your back, hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Kick them up and down in small, quick moves.
ex_dumbbell_rdl_steps:
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, knees soft.
Push the hips back and lower the weights along the legs, back flat.
Stand up by squeezing the glutes.
ex_triceps_extension_steps:
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Bend the elbows and lower it behind your head.
Straighten the arms again; elbows point up.
ex_pilates_double_leg_steps:
Lie on your back, knees to chest, head and shoulders up.
Reach the arms back and stretch both legs long.
Circle the arms round and hug the knees again.
ex_pilates_scissors_steps:
Lie on your back, head and shoulders up, legs straight up.
Lower one leg while holding the other towards you.
Switch legs with two small pulses.
ex_pilates_leg_pull_steps:
Start in a high plank, body in one line.
Lift one straight leg without moving the hips.
Lower it and switch legs.
ex_pilates_spine_stretch_steps:
Sit tall, legs straight and apart, arms forward.
Breathe out and round forward, one vertebra at a time.
Roll back up to sitting tall.
ex_pilates_shoulder_bridge_steps:
Lift the hips into a bridge, feet flat.
Kick one straight leg up to the ceiling.
Lower it with control; keep the hips high, then switch.
ex_pilates_rolling_steps:
Sit and hug your shins, feet off the floor, back round.
Roll back onto your shoulder blades.
Roll up again and balance; don't roll onto your neck.
